input.command:
probe() {
  ip=$1; port=$2
  out=$(wget -T 1 -O /dev/null "http://$ip:$port/" 2>&1)
  if echo "$out" | grep -q "Saving to"; then echo "OPEN  $ip:$port";
  elif echo "$out" | grep -qi "HTTP/1.1 [2345]"; then echo "HTTP  $ip:$port :: $(echo "$out"|grep -o 'HTTP/1.1 [0-9]* [A-Za-z ]*'|head -1)";
  fi
}
# Wider sweep on the two known hosts
for ip in 172.21.0.1 172.21.0.2; do
  for port in 22 25 80 111 139 443 445 587 631 993 995 2001 2082 2083 2086 2087 2095 2096 3000 3001 3128 4000 4443 5000 5001 5432 5601 5672 6379 7070 8000 8008 8010 8080 8081 8082 8085 8086 8088 8090 8181 8182 8443 8888 9000 9001 9090 9091 9200 9300 27017; do
    probe $ip $port
  done
done
echo "=== sweep done ==="

input.command:
cd /work
echo "=== file listing ==="; ls -la
echo "=== size ==="; wc -c SystemContext.svg
echo "=== basic tag balance check (open vs close for key elements) ==="
for t in svg g rect line circle text marker path defs; do
  o=$(grep -o "<$t[ >]" SystemContext.svg | wc -l)
  c=$(grep -o "</$t>" SystemContext.svg | wc -l)
  s=$(grep -o "<$t/>" SystemContext.svg | wc -l)
  echo "$t: open=$o close=$c selfclose=$s"
done
echo "=== head/tail ==="; head -1 SystemContext.svg; tail -1 SystemContext.svg
